_ja_generic_regular.note: Scarlet & Violet regular/enhanced box 30 packs x 5: AR exactly 3, RR ~4 (4-5), "SR or better" 1 per box (SR ~75-80%, SAR ~15-20%, UR ~10%; SAR/UR take the SR slot), 2-hit boxes 5-10% (in a 2-hit box one R is dropped), ACE SPEC exactly 1 in sets that have it. PokeGet carton averages are pooled over ~8,000 (SV5a-SV7a) and ~15,000 (SV9-SV10) SV boxes. torecamap tallies put SAR (~15-25%) and UR (~5-9%) somewhat lower.

_ja_generic_regular_mega.note: MEGA regular box 30 packs x 5: Item/Tool/Stadium SR exactly 1 (separate slot) + SR(Pokemon/Supporter) ~80% + SAR ~28-34% + MUR ~1-2% per box (9-19 per 1,000 boxes by set; 1.5% used here), AR exactly 3, RR ~4. Ultra Rare here = all SR including the item SR.

_ja_generic_high_class.note: High-class box 10 packs x 10, 1 ex (RR) per pack (8-9 RR per box). Each high-class set guarantees exactly one of its signature hit per box (SV4a SSR, SV8a Pokemon SAR, M2a MA) and the SR/SAR/UR slot is NOT guaranteed (SV4a ~0.5/box, SV8a ~0.36/box beyond the guaranteed SAR, M2a ~0.5/box). Other rarities differ too much by set to generalise. God pack: PokeGet pooled ~10,000 high-class boxes -> 1 per 30-50 boxes (1 in 300-500 packs); torecamap measured MEGA Dream ex at 0.75%/box (1 in ~1,340 packs).

_ja_intl.note: Korean and Traditional Chinese (Taiwan/HK) print the same Japanese sets under the same codes and box formats: regular/enhanced boxes 30 packs x 5 (retail listings for KR Cyber Judge/Triplet Beat and TC Triplet Beat/Battle Partners/Glory of Team Rocket); KR and TC Pokemon Card 151 boxes are 20 packs (TC 7 cards/pack, same as JP). No language-specific pull-rate tallies were found for KR/TC, so the Japanese rates are the best available; no sourced KR god-pack difference was found. Thai and Indonesian share one structure (PokeGuardian 2019: Indonesian "has the same set structure as Pokemon TCG Thailand") and are printed in Japan; current Indonesian boxes are 30 packs x 5 (MA5I, SV9sI listings) and Indonesian MEGA Dream ex is 10 packs x 10. But many Indonesian (and some Thai) SV sets merge two Japanese sets: by the app's own printed counts id-SV3s (170 = SV3 108 + SV3a 62), id-SV4s (132 = SV4K + SV4M), id-SV5s (142 = SV5K + SV5M), id-SV7s / th-SV7s (166 = SV7 + SV7a), and probably id-SV6s, id-SV8s / th-SV8s, id-SV9s / th-SV9s. For merged sets the per-box structure is presumably the same but each rarity has about twice as many cards, so per-card odds roughly halve; no tallies found. Simplified Chinese (mainland) is a separate product line (CSV#C expansions, CBB Gem Packs, 151C Gathering/Journey/Hope/Surprise boxes) with different contents and formats, e.g. 151C Gathering standard box 15 packs x 5, jumbo box 6 packs x 20, Gem Pack 18 packs x 4 per retailer listings; third-party guides say SC boxes print per-card odds on the box (e.g. 1.81% per card, Gem Pack Vol.5) and do not guarantee an S/SAR the way JP/TC boxes do, so Japanese rates should not be used for SC. The app's zh-cn-SV7/SV8a/SV9 entries carry Traditional-character names, so they may really be TC prints.

ja-SV8a.note: High-class box 10 packs x 10, 1 ex (RR) per pack -> RR 9/box. PokeGet tally of 2,000 boxes: Pokemon SAR exactly 1/box (27 kinds; guaranteed), SR 20% (12), Supporter SAR 10% (6), UR 6% (5), Master Ball mirror ~50%, ACE SPEC 1/box (no ACE rarity in the app), 2-hit boxes ~40%. torecamap (~220 boxes): SAR 124.09%, SR 19.09%, UR 6.8%, Master Ball 50.91% per box, which agrees. App buckets do not match JP codes (Ultra Rare 43 + Special illustration rare 4 + Hyper rare 3 = the 50 secret cards, which are SR 12 + SAR 33 + UR 5), so the ~1.3 SR/SAR per box is converted to a per-card rate (1.3 / 45 SR+SAR cards) and applied to the 43 Ultra Rare and 4 SIR cards (a derived split; check against card lists). God pack (6 mirrors + 3 Eevee SAR, or 9 Eevee SAR): no set-specific rate; PokeGet pooled high-class figure ~1 per 30-50 boxes = 1 in 300-500 packs -> 400, low confidence (cuberoomblog: 3-SAR packs maybe ~1 per carton, anecdotal).

_meta.format: rates: 1-in-N packs for ANY card of that rarity (N = 100/percent; 1 decimal under 20). G: keys = subset/gallery groups as in packs.js. "a|b" inside a G: key is one shared group rate.
_meta.changed_rule: true if the set is new to PULL_RATES, adds a rarity key, or any value differs from packs.js by more than 10%. Dropped unsourced keys are listed in the note.
